studies.null_hit_distribution: EXACT_UNIFORM_TICKET uses Hypergeometric(45,6,6); TARGET_OUTCOME_PERMUTATION permutes observed target draws relative to frozen t-1 tickets; TEMPORAL_BLOCK_PERMUTATION permutes 20-target outcome blocks relative to those tickets; SIGNAL_RANK_RANDOM_SCORE selects six numbers from independent random score rankings against observed target outcomes.
studies.familywise_family: six registered E037 candidate families x three endpoints
studies.permutation_rule: Use frozen E037 predictions only as pre-target objects; do not score the unpermuted candidate/target alignment during calibration.
studies.max_statistic: max(delta_mean_hits/0.03, delta_rate_3plus/0.01, delta_rate_4plus/0.003) across all six candidates
studies.acceptance: each mechanism and pooled independent verification false-promotion rate <= 0.05

studies.target_information_rule: target t may use rounds 1..t-1 only
studies.uncertainty: paired circular moving-block bootstrap CI, block length 20, 4000 replicates
studies.p_value: one-sided exact sign test across contiguous 50-target block deltas; Holm correction across six families
studies.survival: E036 gate calibrated, nonduplicate formula, CI lower > 0, Holm p < 0.05, >=60% positive blocks
studies.tuning: none; formulas and parameters frozen in source before workflow execution

studies.selection_rule: Only nonduplicate E037 survivors; do not fabricate families to satisfy minimum count of three

studies.condition: Run only for E038 survivors; compare same targets to exact random, B, E026, and E031 frozen outputs
Use only the null-only E036 frozen gate and require every registered criterion
Run only if E040 has a validated edge; otherwise BLOCKED_NO_VALIDATED_SINGLE_EDGE
PROMOTE_TO_PROSPECTIVE_SHADOW only if all registered E041 vs RANDOM_5_LINES criteria pass; otherwise DO_NOT_PROMOTE
